breakdown.description: `ISIF = 3` relaxes the cell even though the workflow specifies a fixed-cell optimization.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth resolves this inconsistency by removing the contradictory task description text ('keep the cell fixed') rather than changing ISIF=3 in the INCAR. The generated specification uses ISIF=3, matching the ground truth INCAR exactly, and does not include the contradictory fixed-cell instruction text.

breakdown.description: `ISPIN = 2` together with an explicit `MAGMOM` line conflicts with the non-spin-polarized setup.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth resolves this inconsistency by removing the contradictory task description text ('non-spin-polarized') rather than changing ISPIN=2 or removing MAGMOM from the INCAR. The generated specification uses ISPIN=2 and MAGMOM=23*-0.001 8*-0.0, matching the ground truth INCAR exactly, and does not include the contradictory non-spin-polarized instruction text.
